paragraphs: AI: "Anthropic Shares Slip as AI and Tech Stock Sell-Off Continues" (The New York Times) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Stocks Often Prosper After an Abrupt C.E.O. Exit. Is Nvidia Different?" (The New York Times).
